title: The Structural Transformation of the Public Space: High-Street Changes and Populism
title_zh: 公共空间的结构转型：商业主街变迁与民粹主义
title_primary: 公共空间的结构转型：商业主街变迁与民粹主义
title_secondary: The Structural Transformation of the Public Space: High-Street Changes and Populism
authors: Stephane Wolton, Samira Gasimova, Ricardo Paccioretti, Giuseppe Palladino
official: 官方在线 2025-02-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The high street serves more than a commercial function. It is the heart of a community. Some of the outlets that line our streets play an important social role, they are third places, communal places beyond work and home. We proxy third places with independent consumer outlets and study how their presence affects the electoral fortune of the UK Independent Party (UKIP), the main populist party in England in our time period (2011-19). Employing both a panel approach and an IV strategy, we find that a decrease in the number of independent consumer outlets yields an increase in the vote share of UKIP. Additional tests indicate that this electoral effect is due in part to the social role played by independent consumer outlets and that the phenomenon we study is distinct from previous cultural explanations for the rise of populists. Analyses of survey data suggest that residential sorting is unlikely to be the main driver behind our electoral results, whereas a loss of social capital in communities where third places disappear is a more plausible mechanism.
abstract_zh: 高街的功能远不止于商业。它是社区的心脏。街道两旁的一些店铺扮演着重要的社会角色，它们是第三场所，即工作与家庭之外的公共空间。我们以独立消费店铺作为第三场所的代理指标，研究其存在如何影响英国独立党（UKIP）——我们研究期间（2011-19年）英格兰主要的民粹主义政党——的选举命运。通过采用面板方法和工具变量策略，我们发现独立消费店铺数量的减少会导致UKIP得票率的上升。进一步测试表明，这一选举效应部分归因于独立消费店铺所发挥的社会角色，且我们所研究的现象与先前关于民粹主义兴起的文化解释有所不同。对调查数据的分析表明，居住分异不太可能是我们选举结果的主要驱动因素，而第三场所消失的社区中社会资本的流失则是一个更为合理的机制。

title: Colleges, Assortative Mating, and Intergenerational Mobility in Twentieth-Century America
title_zh: 二十世纪美国的大学、同型婚配与代际流动
title_primary: 二十世纪美国的大学、同型婚配与代际流动
title_secondary: Colleges, Assortative Mating, and Intergenerational Mobility in Twentieth-Century America
authors: Ran Abramitzky, Santiago Pérez, Joseph Price
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use newly digitized records for 1.2 million students at 60 co-educational U.S. colleges, 1915–1943, linked to enrollment records for their children through 1963, to study how colleges shape marital matching and the intergenerational transmission of educational advantage. About 6% of men and 9% of women marry someone from their own college. This homogamy is largely causal: within colleges, more different-sex classmates and longer campus overlap both raise same-college marriage. Same-college spouses are more educated, and this advantage persists across generations. Children of same-college couples more often attend selective colleges, with spousal education explaining a third of the gap.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1915至1943年间美国60所男女合校大学120万名学生的全新数字化记录，并将其与截至1963年其子女的入学记录相链接，以研究大学如何塑造婚姻匹配及教育优势的代际传递。约6%的男性和9%的女性与本校校友结婚。这种同质性婚姻在很大程度上具有因果性：在校内，更多异性同学及更长的校园重叠时间均提高了同校婚姻的概率。同校配偶的教育程度更高，且这一优势在代际间持续存在。同校夫妇的子女更常进入精英大学，其中配偶教育水平解释了这一差距的三分之一。

title: Gender Differences in Job Search: Trading off Commute Against Wage
title_zh: 求职中的性别差异：通勤与工资的权衡
title_primary: 求职中的性别差异：通勤与工资的权衡
title_secondary: Gender Differences in Job Search: Trading off Commute Against Wage
authors: Thomas Le Barbanchon, Roland Rathelot, Alexandra Roulet, Gaetano Basso, Maria De Paola 等
official: 官方在线 2020-08-19 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper we relate gender differences in willingness to commute to the gender wage gap. Using unique administrative data on job search criteria, we first document that unemployed women have a lower reservation wage than comparable men and that the maximum commute they are willing to accept is smaller. We also find that they get lower wages and shorter commutes in their next job. We then identify indifference curves between wage and commute using the joint distributions of reservation job attributes and of accepted job bundles. Indifference curves are steeper for women, who value commute around 20% more than men. Through the lens of a job search model where commuting matters, we estimate that around 10% of the gender wage gap is accounted for by gender differences in the willingness to pay for a shorter commute. Finally, we use job application data to test the robustness of our results and to show that female workers do not receive less demand from far-away employers, confirming that most of the gender gap in commute is supply-side driven.
abstract_zh: 本文将通勤意愿的性别差异与性别工资差距联系起来。利用关于求职标准的独特行政数据，我们首先记录到，失业女性的保留工资低于条件相当的男性，且她们愿意接受的最大通勤距离也更短。我们还发现，她们在下一份工作中获得的工资较低，通勤距离也较短。接着，我们利用保留工作属性与已接受工作组合的联合分布，识别出工资与通勤之间的无差异曲线。女性的无差异曲线更为陡峭，她们对通勤的重视程度比男性高出约20%。通过一个考虑通勤因素的工作搜索模型，我们估计，性别工资差距中约有10%可由女性对缩短通勤的支付意愿差异来解释。最后，我们利用求职申请数据来检验结果的稳健性，并表明女性劳动者并未收到来自远距离雇主的更少需求，从而确认通勤性别差距主要源于供给方因素。

title: Mapping the Grandes Gabelles in early modern France
title_zh: 绘制近代早期法国大盐仓分布图
title_primary: 绘制近代早期法国大盐仓分布图
title_secondary: Mapping the Grandes Gabelles in early modern France
authors: Eva Davoine, Joseph Enguehard, Victor Gay, Igor Kolesnikov
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The gabelle salt tax system was a cornerstone of the fiscal apparatus of the early modern French state. This article introduces a novel historical geographic information system (GIS) of this institution’s spatial organization as of the seventeenth century, drawing on an original 1665 manuscript map collection: Sanson’s Atlas des gabelles . Beyond presenting the dataset and documenting its construction methodology, we provide a detailed account of the functioning of the gabelle, situate the French case in comparative perspective, and illustrate how the availability of this fine-grained dataset expands the possibilities of empirical research in economic history, historical demography, and historical political economy of early modern France.
abstract_zh: 盐税制度（gabelle）是近代早期法国国家财政架构的基石。本文基于1665年手稿地图集——桑松的《盐税图志》，引入了一套关于该制度在十七世纪空间组织的新历史地理信息系统（GIS）。除展示数据集并记录其构建方法外，我们详细阐述了盐税制度的运作机制，将法国案例置于比较视角中，并说明这一精细数据集的可用性如何拓展了经济史、历史人口学及近代早期法国历史政治经济学领域的实证研究可能性。

title: How does artificial intelligence investment optimize the skill structure of enterprise labour force? Evidence from Chinese listed companies
title_zh: 人工智能投资如何优化企业劳动力技能结构？来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 人工智能投资如何优化企业劳动力技能结构？来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: How does artificial intelligence investment optimize the skill structure of enterprise labour force? Evidence from Chinese listed companies
authors: Xiwei Sun, Yuhan Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Artificial intelligence is becoming a key input in corporate transformation, yet its effects on workforce skill structure remain underexplored. Drawing on skill-biased technological change theory, this study examines AI investment’s effect on the share of highly educated labour and the mediating role of administrative expense ratio. Using panel data of Chinese A-share listed firms (2015–2024), this research finds that a 1% increase in AI investment raises the proportion of employees with a master’s degree or above by about 0.0009% points – significant but modest, reflecting high-skilled talent supply lag. The direct positive effect is partially offset by an indirect negative effect via reduced administrative expense ratio. The effect is strongest in services, weaker in industry, and insignificant in agriculture; it is also significant in non-state-owned enterprises but not in state-owned ones. These findings suggest AI affects skill structure through both production and organizational channels, with implications for firm strategy and policy. KEYWORDS: Artificial intelligence investment skill structure of the corporate workforce administrative expense ratio skill-biased technological change theory JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 G15
abstract_zh: 人工智能正成为企业转型的关键投入要素，但其对劳动力技能结构的影响尚未得到充分探讨。基于技能偏向型技术变革理论，本研究考察了人工智能投资对高学历劳动力占比的影响，以及管理费用率的中介作用。利用2015—2024年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，研究发现：人工智能投资每增加1%，硕士及以上学历员工占比约提高0.0009个百分点——这一效应虽显著但幅度较小，反映出高技能人才供给的滞后性。直接正向效应部分被管理费用率下降带来的间接负向效应所抵消。该效应在服务业中最强，在工业中较弱，在农业中不显著；在非国有企业中显著，在国有企业中则不显著。这些发现表明，人工智能通过生产渠道和组织渠道共同影响技能结构，对企业战略与政策制定具有启示意义。关键词：人工智能投资；企业劳动力技能结构；管理费用率；技能偏向型技术变革理论；JEL分类：O33 G15

title: Who Has the Upper HAND in a Hurricane?
title_zh: 谁在飓风中占据上风？
title_primary: 谁在飓风中占据上风？
title_secondary: Who Has the Upper HAND in a Hurricane?
authors: Julian A. Plough, Sheila M. Olmstead, Douglas H. Wrenn
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Flood risk is increasing in the United States, but how property markets respond to this hazard is unclear. Focusing on Houston, Texas, we analyze changes in flood risk capitalization in property prices after three major Gulf Coast hurricanes. We compare two measures of flood risk–floodplain designations from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), and a hydrologically-imputed, continuous measure, Height Above the Nearest Drainage (HAND). HAND affects property prices after a storm in intuitive ways, while we observe counterintuitive post-storm price premiums within FEMA floodplains. Plausibly exogenous measures like HAND may be useful tools for characterizing flood risk in economic analyses.
abstract_zh: 摘要 美国洪水风险日益加剧，但房地产市场如何应对这一灾害尚不明确。本文以德克萨斯州休斯顿为研究对象，分析三次重大墨西哥湾飓风后洪水风险资本化对房产价格的影响。我们比较了两种洪水风险衡量指标——联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）划定的洪泛区，以及基于水文模拟的连续指标“最近排水高度”（HAND）。研究发现，HAND在飓风后以直观方式影响房产价格，而FEMA洪泛区内的房产在飓风后却出现反直觉的价格溢价。具有外生性特征的指标（如HAND）或可作为经济分析中刻画洪水风险的有效工具。

abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个动态劳动力市场互动的典型模型，其中劳动力重新配置成本部分由未参保工人的消费流承担。在由此产生的次优均衡中，若将劳动力重新配置成本转移至风险中性雇主的政策安排，其行政无谓成本不过高，则可提升生产效率；且只要雇主的解雇成本至少部分用于资助工人的流动性，就能增加工人福利。

title: The Performative Role of Soft Skills Education: Reshaping Business Realities through Cross-Cultural Learning in Chinese Organizations
title_zh: 软技能教育的表演性角色：通过中国组织中的跨文化学习重塑商业现实
title_primary: 软技能教育的表演性角色：通过中国组织中的跨文化学习重塑商业现实
title_secondary: The Performative Role of Soft Skills Education: Reshaping Business Realities through Cross-Cultural Learning in Chinese Organizations
authors: Wu, Jie, Canales, J. Ignacio, Zhou, Peng, Yan, Haifeng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines how soft skills education performatively shapes business realities across cultural boundaries. While prior research has treated soft skills as static capabilities, we demonstrate their role as performative forces actively reshaping organizational practices. Through in-depth interviews with Chinese graduates of UK universities working in China, our findings reveal an inverted U-shaped relationship between structural performativity and organizational transformation, moderated by collective orientation (weakening effect) and absorptive capacity (strengthening effect) and pinpoint six key domains through which soft skills education acts as a performative mechanism. Our findings suggest that successful organizational transformation through soft skills education requires balancing international connections, cultural values, and knowledge integration capabilities. The study advances performativity theory in management education by demonstrating how educational practices actively construct organizational realities rather than merely describing them and provides insights for business schools on effectively harnessing performativity to create desirable organizational outcomes in cross-cultural contexts.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨软技能教育如何以表演性方式跨越文化边界塑造商业现实。既有研究将软技能视为静态能力，而本文揭示其作为表演性力量主动重塑组织实践的机制。通过对在华工作的英国高校中国毕业生进行深度访谈，研究发现结构性表演性与组织转型呈倒U型关系，集体主义导向（弱化效应）与吸收能力（强化效应）对该关系起调节作用，并识别出软技能教育发挥表演性机制的六大关键领域。研究结果表明，通过软技能教育实现成功的组织转型需要平衡国际联结、文化价值观与知识整合能力。本研究通过论证教育实践如何主动构建而非简单描述组织现实，推进了管理教育领域的表演性理论发展，并为商学院在跨文化情境中有效利用表演性创造理想组织成果提供实践启示。

title: Human Capital and Climate Change
title_zh: 人力资本与气候变化
title_primary: 人力资本与气候变化
title_secondary: Human Capital and Climate Change
authors: Noam Angrist, Kevin Winseck, Harry Anthony Patrinos, Joshua Graff Zivin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavior change and voter support for pro-climate policies, yet surprisingly little is known about how to achieve these outcomes. In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而令人惊讶的是，关于如何实现这些目标的研究甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家的新义务教育法数据，估算了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，并纳入了关于政策偏好和投票支持绿党的新数据。结果表明，每增加一年教育会显著提升亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。

title: Identifying Monetary Policy Shocks: A Natural Language Approach
title_zh: 识别货币政策冲击：一种自然语言方法
title_primary: 识别货币政策冲击：一种自然语言方法
title_secondary: Identifying Monetary Policy Shocks: A Natural Language Approach
authors: Aruoba, S. Borağan, Drechsel, Thomas
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a novel method for the identification of monetary policy shocks. By applying natural language processing techniques to documents that Federal Reserve staff prepare in advance of policy decisions, we capture the Fed's information set. Using machine learning techniques, we then predict changes in the target interest rate conditional on this information set and obtain a measure of monetary policy shocks as the residual. We show that the documents' text contains essential information about the economy which is not captured by numerical forecasts. The dynamic responses of macro variables to our shocks are consistent with the theoretical consensus.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种识别货币政策冲击的新方法。通过将自然语言处理技术应用于美联储工作人员在政策决策前准备的文件，我们捕捉了美联储的信息集。随后，利用机器学习技术，我们基于该信息集预测目标利率的变化，并将残差作为货币政策冲击的度量。研究表明，这些文件文本包含了未被数值预测所涵盖的关键经济信息。宏观变量对冲击的动态响应与理论共识一致。

title: Institutional opening and foreign investment commitment: evidence from China’s Free Trade Zones
title_zh: 制度型开放与外商投资承诺：来自中国自贸区的证据
title_primary: 制度型开放与外商投资承诺：来自中国自贸区的证据
title_secondary: Institutional opening and foreign investment commitment: evidence from China’s Free Trade Zones
authors: Fengge Yao, Xiaojia Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Institutional opening has emerged as a significant policy instrument for shaping long-term investment decisions, particularly when the marginal effects of factor-based opening become less pronounced and foreign investment becomes increasingly sensitive to the institutional environment and policy expectations. This paper treats the establishment of a pilot free trade zone (FTZ) in a region with relatively weak institutional foundations as a quasi-natural experiment. Using provincial panel data from 2008 to 2022, this study applies the synthetic control method and the synthetic difference-in-differences method to test the impact of FTZ policies on the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises. The results show that FTZ policies significantly increased the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises in the treated province, with an average policy effect of approximately 34.4%. Further analysis indicates that this effect is primarily reflected in the growth in medium- and long-term investment arrangements rather than increases in current capital inflows alone. This finding suggests that institutional opening can promote foreign investment by enhancing investors’ expectations regarding institutional stability and policy predictability. Comparisons across regions also indicate that the effect is stronger in regions with relatively weak institutional foundations, whereas the marginal effect is smaller in regions with more developed institutional conditions.
abstract_zh: 制度型开放已成为塑造长期投资决策的重要政策工具，尤其是在要素型开放的边际效应逐渐减弱、外资对制度环境与政策预期日益敏感的背景下。本文将自由贸易试验区在制度基础相对薄弱地区的设立视为准自然实验，利用2008—2022年省级面板数据，采用合成控制法和合成双重差分法检验自贸区政策对外商投资企业投资总额的影响。结果表明，自贸区政策显著提升了处理省份外商投资企业的投资总额，平均政策效应约为34.4%。进一步分析显示，这一效应主要体现在中长期投资安排的增长，而非当期资本流入的增加。这一发现表明，制度型开放能够通过增强投资者对制度稳定性和政策可预期性的预期来促进外商投资。跨区域比较也显示，在制度基础相对薄弱的地区，该效应更为显著，而在制度条件较为完善的地区，边际效应较小。

title: The (Many) Consequences of the Housing Affordability Problem in the EU: A Machine-Learning Empirical Analysis
title_zh: 欧盟住房可负担性问题的（多重）后果：一项基于机器学习的实证分析
title_primary: 欧盟住房可负担性问题的（多重）后果：一项基于机器学习的实证分析
title_secondary: The (Many) Consequences of the Housing Affordability Problem in the EU: A Machine-Learning Empirical Analysis
authors: Mr. Jean-Jacques Hallaert & Iglika Vassileva
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Housing affordability is high on the economic, social, and political agenda in Europe. While the economic literature has mostly analyzed the drivers of housing unaffordability, this paper focuses on its consequences, quantifying, at the EU level, its impact on individuals’ well-being as well as its economic and demographic impact. We find that the impact of an increase in housing cost burden is large on housing adequacy as well as on poverty and health. It is somewhat smaller on fertility and labor force participation.
abstract_zh: 住房可负担性在欧洲的经济、社会和政治议程中占据重要地位。尽管经济学文献主要分析了住房不可负担性的驱动因素，本文则聚焦于其后果，在欧盟层面量化其对个人福祉的影响，以及其经济和人口层面的影响。研究发现，住房成本负担增加对住房适足性、贫困和健康的影响较大，而对生育率和劳动力参与率的影响相对较小。

title: Optimal Combination of Patent Instruments in a Cumulative-Innovation Growth Model
title_zh: 累积创新增长模型中专利工具的最优组合
title_primary: 累积创新增长模型中专利工具的最优组合
title_secondary: Optimal Combination of Patent Instruments in a Cumulative-Innovation Growth Model
authors: Davin Chor, Edwin L.-C. Lai
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a tractable general equilibrium model of cumulative innovation and growth to study the optimal combinations of three patent instruments: a patentability requirement to protect against future incremental innovation, a patent breadth to protect against current imitation, and the patent length governing the duration of its validity. New ideas strictly build upon frontier technologies, with the size of productivity improvements drawn from a stochastic distribution. The model features positive knowledge spillovers, and we discuss when this leads to under-investment in R&D in the market equilibrium relative to the social planner’s benchmark. We characterize analytically how each patent instrument affects research incentives, and further establish that the patentability requirement and patent breadth in the welfare-maximizing combination are each set at a strictly lower level than in the R&D-maximizing combination. Calibrating the model to aggregate data, the welfare-maximizing combination of instruments features a large patent breadth, a long patent duration, but a modest patentability requirement. The quantitative analysis points to sizeable welfare gains from these patent policies, while highlighting the importance of having multiple patent instruments.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个易于处理的累积创新与增长一般均衡模型，旨在研究三种专利工具的最优组合：保护未来增量创新的可专利性要求、保护当前模仿的专利宽度，以及决定其有效期限的专利长度。新思想严格建立在尖端技术之上，生产力改进的规模从随机分布中抽取。模型包含正向知识溢出效应，我们讨论了在何种情况下，这会导致市场均衡中的研发投资相对于社会规划者基准而言不足。我们分析性地刻画了每种专利工具如何影响研究激励，并进一步确立，在福利最大化组合中，可专利性要求和专利宽度均严格低于研发最大化组合中的水平。将模型校准至总体数据后，福利最大化的工具组合表现为较大的专利宽度、较长的专利期限，但适度的可专利性要求。定量分析指出这些专利政策能带来显著的福利收益，同时强调了拥有多种专利工具的重要性。

title: Disentangling the distributional effects of financial shocks in the euro area
title_zh: 欧元区金融冲击的分配效应解析
title_primary: 欧元区金融冲击的分配效应解析
title_secondary: Disentangling the distributional effects of financial shocks in the euro area
authors: Milos Ciganovic, Elena Scola Gagliardi, Massimiliano Tancioni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how financial shocks affect the income distribution in the euro area. Using survey-based microdata from 16 countries and a functional pooled panel VAR, we trace impulse responses of the full income distribution. Positive financial shocks increase gross market income inequality: upper-tail incomes rise persistently, whereas lower-tail incomes weaken on impact and recover gradually, even as the mass at zero income declines. Decomposing income into property and labor components reveals two transmission channels. Property income responds quickly, consistent with asset-price revaluation and concentrated financial asset holdings. Labor income responds more gradually and persistently, consistent with broader labor-market adjustment in margins and composition. We also document asymmetries: financial expansions raise inequality, whereas financial contractions initially compress top incomes. The asymmetry is strongest for financial asset income.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击如何影响欧元区的收入分配。利用来自16个国家的基于调查的微观数据以及功能性面板VAR模型，我们追踪了完整收入分布的脉冲响应。正向金融冲击加剧了总市场收入不平等：高收入端收入持续上升，而低收入端收入在冲击初期减弱并逐步恢复，即便零收入群体的比例有所下降。将收入分解为财产性收入和劳动收入后，揭示了两种传导渠道。财产性收入反应迅速，与资产价格重估及金融资产持有集中度一致。劳动收入反应则更为渐进且持久，与劳动力市场在边际和构成上的广泛调整相符。我们还记录了不对称性：金融扩张加剧不平等，而金融收缩初期压缩高收入端收入。这种不对称性在金融资产收入中表现最为显著。

title: Functional integration by parts formulae for stochastic Volterra processes
title_zh: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式
title_primary: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式
title_secondary: Functional integration by parts formulae for stochastic Volterra processes
authors: Alexandre Pannier
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate integration by parts (IBP) formulae for stochastic Volterra equations and we establish the smoothing effect of the expectation. Due to the inherent path-dependent dynamics of this class of processes, standard Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL) formulae and lifting procedures fail to produce representations for directional derivatives with respect to the initial curve. We exhibit a new type of fractional IBP for these derivatives which, by means of the Riemann--Liouville fractional derivative, interpolates between the standard chain rule and a pure BEL formula with Cameron--Martin path directions. Our assumptions describe precisely the trade-off between the direction's and the test function's regularities. Crucially, we reveal that more roughness leads to more smoothing: for a power-law kernel with Hurst parameter $H\in(0, 1/2)$, we show that the expectation is differentiable along constant directions provided that the test function has H\"older continuity $\beta>2H$. The proof of the formula relies on a careful analysis of the conditional expectation's temporal regularity and on the well-posedness of its Riemann--Liouville derivative. We complement these results with a BEL formula along all square integrable directions whenever the noise is additive, a second order BEL formula and an application to forward and rough volatility models. In the latter case, the derivative is interpreted as the sensitivity with respect to the whole initial forward variance curve.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机Volterra方程的分部积分公式，并建立了期望的平滑效应。由于这类过程固有的路径依赖动力学特性，标准的Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL)公式和提升方法无法生成关于初始曲线的方向导数表示。我们针对这些导数提出了一种新型分数阶分部积分公式，该公式通过Riemann--Liouville分数阶导数，在标准链式法则与包含Cameron--Martin路径方向的纯BEL公式之间进行插值。我们的假设精确描述了方向正则性与测试函数正则性之间的权衡关系。关键的是，我们发现更粗糙的路径会导致更强的平滑效应：对于Hurst参数$H\in(0, 1/2)$的幂律核，我们证明只要测试函数具有Hölder连续性$\beta>2H$，期望沿恒定方向是可微的。该公式的证明依赖于对条件期望时间正则性的细致分析及其Riemann--Liouville导数的适定性。我们进一步补充了以下结果：当噪声为加性时，沿所有平方可积方向的BEL公式、二阶BEL公式，以及在远期和粗糙波动率模型中的应用。在后一种情况下，导数被解释为对整条初始远期方差曲线的敏感性。

title: The Discretionary Color Line in International Institutions
title_zh: 国际机构中的自由裁量种族界限
title_primary: 国际机构中的自由裁量种族界限
title_secondary: The Discretionary Color Line in International Institutions
authors: Rosenberg, Andrew
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A growing literature documents racial hierarchy in international institutions. I test whether formally equal rules eliminate that hierarchy in practice. The Schengen visa regime offers a hard case because member states process applications under identical law. I show that ancestral distance, a measure of perceived racial difference, predicts visa refusals. Contemporary ancestral distance drives the result. A pre-1500 measure does not, consistent with the social construction of race. A consulate-level analysis isolates the discretionary channel. Busier consulates discriminate more against ancestrally distant applicants, even though a nationality's risk profile does not change with consular workload. Routine operational pressures activate the categorical shortcuts that institutional design was supposed to prevent. A further test shows the effect is stronger where national populations hold more restrictive racial attitudes, not where institutional capacity is weakest. Harmonized rules do not eliminate international institutional racism. They push it into discretionary gaps that formal law cannot close.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献揭示了国际机构中的种族等级现象。本文检验了形式上平等的规则是否能在实践中消除这种等级。申根签证制度提供了一个典型案例，因为成员国依据相同的法律处理签证申请。研究表明，祖先距离（一种感知种族差异的衡量指标）能够预测签证拒签率。当代祖先距离是驱动这一结果的关键因素，而1500年之前的祖先距离则无显著影响，这与种族的社会建构属性一致。领事馆层面的分析揭示了自由裁量渠道的作用。工作更繁忙的领事馆对祖先距离较远的申请人歧视更严重，尽管国籍的风险特征并不随领事馆工作量变化。常规操作压力激活了制度设计本应防止的类别化捷径。进一步检验表明，这种效应在国民种族态度更保守的地区更为显著，而非在制度能力最弱的地区。统一规则并未消除国际制度中的种族主义，而是将其推向了正式法律无法填补的自由裁量空间。

title: A study on asset-light operation and enterprise innovation performance——empirical evidence from listed Chinese enterprises
title_zh: 轻资产运营与企业创新绩效研究——来自中国上市企业的经验证据
title_primary: 轻资产运营与企业创新绩效研究——来自中国上市企业的经验证据
title_secondary: A study on asset-light operation and enterprise innovation performance——empirical evidence from listed Chinese enterprises
authors: Xiang Hui, Bingxiang Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how asset-light operation affects corporate innovation performance using data on Chinese listed firms from 2012 to 2023. Employing two-way fixed effects models, we find that asset-light operation significantly enhances innovation performance. Mechanism analysis shows that innovation investment, innovation output, innovation efficiency, and supply chain digitalization (particularly planning, production, sales, and logistics) serve as mediating channels. New digital infrastructure positively moderates this relationship. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the promoting effect is more pronounced in eastern regions, firms with effective internal control, state‑owned enterprises, and high‑tech sectors. The study extends the literature by shifting the focus from cost‑saving financial strategies to agility and resource orchestration, and by incorporating supply chain digitalization and new digital infrastructure as key mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2012至2023年中国上市公司数据，探讨了轻资产运营如何影响企业创新绩效。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现轻资产运营显著提升了创新绩效。机制分析表明，创新投入、创新产出、创新效率及供应链数字化（尤其是规划、生产、销售与物流环节）构成了中介渠道。新型数字基础设施对此关系起到正向调节作用。异质性分析显示，在东部地区、内部控制有效的企业、国有企业及高科技行业中，这种促进作用更为显著。本研究通过将关注点从节约成本的财务策略转向灵活性与资源编排，并将供应链数字化及新型数字基础设施纳入关键机制，拓展了相关文献。

title: Building resilience in the Global South: Evidence from a decentralized water policy in Brazil
title_zh: 增强全球南方韧性：来自巴西分散式水政策的证据
title_primary: 增强全球南方韧性：来自巴西分散式水政策的证据
title_secondary: Building resilience in the Global South: Evidence from a decentralized water policy in Brazil
authors: Marcelo S.O. Goncalves
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate change poses increasing risks to population well-being through heightened water scarcity. This threat is particularly pronounced in low-income and climate-vulnerable regions, where traditional water infrastructure may not be feasible in the near term. This study evaluates the effectiveness of a decentralized water policy as a climate adaptation strategy, focusing on Brazil's Cisterns Program, a large-scale rainwater harvesting initiative designed to build climate resilience in remote, underserved communities. The analysis shows that access to rainwater harvesting reduces severe cases of waterborne diseases by approximately 34%. Beyond these average health gains, the study assesses climate resilience by examining how the program moderates the impacts of drought shocks. Using multiple definitions of drought, the analysis shows that these events substantially increase disease burden. However, these adverse effects are significantly mitigated or fully offset by the program, indicating a sharp reduction in vulnerability to climate-related stress. Evidence on mechanisms suggests that effectiveness depends not only on water availability but also on beneficiaries' capacity to manage water safely and on program implementation. Impacts are significantly larger in more educated communities and where local civil-society organizations play a central role in implementation. These findings highlight the potential of low-cost, decentralized interventions as viable climate adaptation strategies, particularly in settings where large-scale infrastructure projects are impractical, and offer a scalable model for resilience-building development policies in the Global South.
abstract_zh: 气候变化通过加剧水资源短缺，对人口福祉构成日益严重的风险。这一威胁在低收入和气候脆弱地区尤为突出，这些地区传统的水利基础设施短期内可能难以实现。本研究评估了分散式水政策作为气候适应策略的有效性，重点关注巴西的“蓄水池计划”——一项旨在为偏远、服务不足社区建立气候韧性的大规模雨水收集倡议。分析显示，获得雨水收集设施可使严重水传播疾病病例减少约34%。除这些平均健康收益外，本研究还通过考察该计划如何调节干旱冲击的影响来评估气候韧性。利用多种干旱定义，分析表明这些事件显著增加了疾病负担。然而，这些不利影响被该计划显著缓解或完全抵消，表明对气候相关压力的脆弱性大幅降低。关于作用机制的证据表明，有效性不仅取决于水资源可用性，还取决于受益者安全用水的能力及项目实施情况。在受教育程度较高的社区以及当地公民社会组织在实施中发挥核心作用的地区，影响显著更大。这些发现凸显了低成本、分散式干预措施作为可行气候适应策略的潜力，尤其是在大型基础设施项目不切实际的环境中，并为全球南方韧性建设发展政策提供了可扩展的模式。

title: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
title_zh: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击
title_primary: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击
title_secondary: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
authors: Lutz Kilian, Michael D. Plante, Alexander W. Richter
official: 官方在线 2026-05-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A common VAR approach is to identify responses to TFP news shocks by maximizing the variance share of TFP over a long horizon. We find that these TFP max share estimators tend to be biased in large samples when applied to data generated from DSGE models with shock processes that match TFP moments in the data, especially in the presence of TFP measurement error. We propose an alternative max share news estimator that reduces this bias and the RMSE of the impulse response estimates, even when there is sizable measurement error in the news variable. When applying this estimator to U.S. data, we find that news shocks are slower to diffuse to TFP and have a smaller effect on real activity than implied by the TFP max share estimator.
abstract_zh: 常见的VAR方法是通过最大化全要素生产率（TFP）在长期内的方差份额来识别对TFP新闻冲击的响应。我们发现，当将这种TFP最大份额估计量应用于由DSGE模型生成的数据时（该模型的冲击过程与数据中的TFP矩相匹配），尤其是在存在TFP测量误差的情况下，这些估计量在大样本中往往存在偏误。我们提出了一种替代性的最大份额新闻估计量，该估计量能够减少这种偏误以及脉冲响应估计的均方根误差（RMSE），即使新闻变量存在显著的测量误差。当将此估计量应用于美国数据时，我们发现新闻冲击对TFP的扩散速度比TFP最大份额估计量所隐含的更慢，且对实际经济活动的影响更小。

title: The consistency principle in the reordering problem
title_zh: 重排序问题中的一致性原则
title_primary: 重排序问题中的一致性原则
title_secondary: The consistency principle in the reordering problem
authors: Min-Hung Tsay, Youngsub Chun, René van den Brink, Chun-Hsien Yeh
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate implications of the consistency principle for the reordering problem, also known as the queueing problem with an initial queue. The consistency principle specifies how an allocation rule should respond when an agent leaves the problem. We introduce four different consistency properties for the reordering problem and characterize three allocations rules, the pairwise equal-splitting rule (Curiel et al. Eur J Operat Res 40:344-351, 1989), the maximum price rule and the minimum price rule. Balanced consistency requires that for each pair of agents i and j , the impact on agent i ’s net utility when agent j leaves the initial queue and the agents behind her move forward by one position, should be equal to the impact on agent j ’s net utility when agent i leaves the initial queue and the agents behind her move forward by one position. Balanced cost reduction requires that if an agent leaves the initial queue and the agents behind her move forward by one position, then the total net utilities of the remaining agents should be reduced by the amount equal to the net utility of the departing agent. Smallest-cost consistency (respectively, largest-cost consistency ) requires that if an agent with the smallest (respectively, largest) unit waiting cost leaves the initial queue and the agents behind her move forward by one position, then the net utilities of the remaining agents should not be affected. We show that either balanced consistency or balanced cost reduction , together with the three basic properties of queue-efficiency , budget-balance and Pareto indifference , characterizes the pairwise equal-splitting rule. On the other hand, together with the three basic properties, smallest-cost consistency characterizes the maximum price rule and largest-cost consistency the minimum price rule.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了一致性原则在重排序问题（即带有初始队列的排队问题）中的含义。一致性原则规定了当一位代理人离开问题时，分配规则应如何响应。我们为重排序问题引入了四种不同的一致性属性，并刻画了三种分配规则：两两均分规则（Curiel等人，欧洲运筹学杂志40:344-351，1989）、最高价格规则和最低价格规则。平衡一致性要求，对于每对代理人i和j，当代理人j离开初始队列且其后的代理人向前移动一位时，对代理人i净效用的影响，应等于当代理人i离开初始队列且其后的代理人向前移动一位时，对代理人j净效用的影响。平衡成本减少要求，如果一位代理人离开初始队列且其后的代理人向前移动一位，则剩余代理人的总净效用应减少，减少量等于离开代理人的净效用。最小成本一致性（分别地，最大成本一致性）要求，如果具有最小（分别地，最大）单位等待成本的代理人离开初始队列且其后的代理人向前移动一位，则剩余代理人的净效用不应受到影响。我们表明，平衡一致性或平衡成本减少，连同队列效率、预算平衡和帕累托无关性这三个基本属性，共同刻画了两两均分规则。另一方面，连同这三个基本属性，最小成本一致性刻画了最高价格规则，而最大成本一致性则刻画了最低价格规则。

title: Development and interdisciplinarity: additional insights on the ‘economics silo’
title_zh: 发展与跨学科性：关于“经济学孤岛”的补充见解
title_primary: 发展与跨学科性：关于“经济学孤岛”的补充见解
title_secondary: Development and interdisciplinarity: additional insights on the ‘economics silo’
authors: Matthias Aistleitner
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Recent scientometric evidence published in this journal (Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinary: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076; hereafter MPV) suggests that development is not an interdisciplinary field as it predominantly references mainstream economics and shows limited interaction with other disciplines. This article validates the study of MPV and extends it in several ways. First, it introduces an alternative method for identifying the economics background of development scholars by matching bibliometric data with the Research Papers in Economics (RePEc) author database. Second, it applies an extensive multi-level citation analysis, based on all journal references available from the Web of Science database. A replication of the cited-reference analysis of 29,619 articles across 17 development journals confirms MPV’s findings: the lack of interdisciplinarity in development is driven primarily by research by authors with an economics background. However, this study estimates a much larger share of such research than MPV. Third, a regression analysis reveals that works authored by economists receive significantly more citations. Fourth, a comparative analysis of author affiliations shows that articles with an economics background are predominantly associated with renowned (international) policy institutions, particularly the World Bank. Fifth, a discursive analysis of article abstracts based on structural topic modeling identifies research topics associated with (non-)economists, and thus, higher or lower levels of interdisciplinarity. Overall, the findings highlight several policy implications as development research conducted by economists differs significantly across multiple dimensions, with these differences being even more pronounced among ‘top-five’ economists.
abstract_zh: 本刊近期发表的一篇科学计量学证据（Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinarity: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076；以下简称MPV）表明，发展研究并非一个跨学科领域，因为它主要引用主流经济学文献，与其他学科的互动有限。本文验证了MPV的研究，并在多个方面进行了拓展。首先，本文引入了一种替代方法，通过将文献计量数据与经济学研究论文（RePEc）作者数据库进行匹配，来识别发展学者的经济学背景。其次，本文基于Web of Science数据库中所有期刊参考文献，进行了广泛的多层次引文分析。对17种发展期刊中29,619篇文章的引文参考文献分析进行复制，证实了MPV的发现：发展研究中跨学科性的缺乏主要由具有经济学背景的作者的研究所驱动。然而，本研究估计此类研究所占比例远高于MPV的估计。第三，回归分析显示，经济学家撰写的著作获得的引用显著更多。第四，对作者所属机构的比较分析表明，具有经济学背景的文章主要与国际知名（国际）政策机构相关，尤其是世界银行。第五，基于结构主题模型对文章摘要进行的话语分析，识别了与（非）经济学家相关的研究主题，从而反映了跨学科性的高低程度。总体而言，研究结果凸显了若干政策启示，因为经济学家开展的发展研究在多个维度上存在显著差异，且这些差异在“五大”经济学家中更为突出。

title: Commodity price uncertainty comovement: Does it matter for global economic growth?
title_zh: 大宗商品价格不确定性的联动性：对全球经济增长重要吗？
title_primary: 大宗商品价格不确定性的联动性：对全球经济增长重要吗？
title_secondary: Commodity price uncertainty comovement: Does it matter for global economic growth?
authors: Laurent Ferrara, Aikaterini Karadimitropoulou, Athanasios Triantafyllou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the macroeconomic effects of commodity price uncertainty by explicitly accounting for comovement across commodity markets. Using quarterly realized volatilities of major agricultural, metals, and energy commodity prices, we estimate a hierarchical dynamic factor model that decomposes uncertainty into a global component, common to all commodities, and group-specific components capturing sectoral uncertainty. The estimated uncertainty factors are then embedded into country-specific Structural VAR models to assess the dynamic macroeconomic responses to uncertainty shocks through impulse response functions. We focus in particular on business investment and exports across a panel of advanced and emerging economies. Our results show that a global commodity price uncertainty shock generates sizable and persistent recessionary effects on investment and trade worldwide. Benchmark comparisons indicate that this global commodity uncertainty shock produces larger and more persistent macroeconomic contractions than standard uncertainty measures. Importantly, we show that, once global uncertainty is accounted for, commodity-specific uncertainty shocks exhibit differentiated effects. Increases in agricultural and metals price uncertainty lead to contractionary outcomes, whereas energy-specific uncertainty shocks generate positive short-run responses in investment and exports. These findings provide new empirical evidence that oil price uncertainty can be expansionary when it reflects sector-specific dynamics rather than global demand uncertainty. Overall, our framework offers a novel way to disentangle “bad” and “good” commodity price uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 我们通过明确考虑大宗商品市场间的联动性，研究大宗商品价格不确定性的宏观经济效应。利用主要农产品、金属和能源大宗商品价格的季度已实现波动率，我们估计了一个层级动态因子模型，将不确定性分解为所有大宗商品共有的全球成分，以及捕捉部门性不确定性的组别特定成分。随后，将估计出的不确定性因子嵌入到国家特定的结构向量自回归模型中，通过脉冲响应函数评估不确定性冲击的动态宏观经济反应。我们特别关注一组发达经济体和新兴经济体中企业投资与出口的表现。结果显示，全球大宗商品价格不确定性冲击在全球范围内对投资和贸易产生了显著且持久的衰退效应。基准比较表明，这种全球大宗商品不确定性冲击比标准不确定性度量引发了更大且更持久的宏观经济收缩。重要的是，我们表明，一旦考虑全球不确定性，大宗商品特定不确定性冲击会表现出差异化效应。农产品和金属价格不确定性的上升导致收缩性结果，而能源特定不确定性冲击则在短期内对投资和出口产生正向反应。这些发现提供了新的经验证据，表明当油价不确定性反映的是部门特定动态而非全球需求不确定性时，其可能具有扩张性。总体而言，我们的框架提供了一种新颖的方法来区分“坏”与“好”的大宗商品价格不确定性。

title: Placebo zones in discontinuity‐based designs: Estimation, inference, and implementation
title_zh: 断点设计中的安慰剂区域：估计、推断与实施
title_primary: 断点设计中的安慰剂区域：估计、推断与实施
title_secondary: Placebo zones in discontinuity‐based designs: Estimation, inference, and implementation
authors: Nathan Kettlewell, Peter Siminski
official: 官方在线 2026-04-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a new model-selection algorithm for regression discontinuity design and related estimators. The performance of candidate models is assessed within a “placebo zone” of the running variable. Candidate models can differ by bandwidth and other choice parameters. We outline (restrictive) sufficient conditions under which the approach is asymptotically optimal, and then show the approach also performs favorably under more general conditions in Monte Carlo simulations, including simulations calibrated to well-known real-world applications. We also propose a new randomization inference procedure which draws on the placebo estimates. Our Stata commands implement the procedure and compare its performance to other approaches.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的模型选择算法，适用于断点回归设计及相关估计量。候选模型的性能在运行变量的“安慰剂区域”内进行评估。候选模型可因带宽及其他选择参数而异。我们概述了在该方法渐近最优的（限制性）充分条件，随后通过蒙特卡洛模拟显示，在更一般条件下该方法同样表现良好，包括针对知名实际应用校准的模拟。我们还提出了一种新的随机化推断程序，该程序利用安慰剂估计。我们的Stata命令实现了该程序，并将其性能与其他方法进行了比较。

title: Network analysis of “top-five” economics journals
title_zh: 五大”经济学期刊的网络分析
title_primary: 五大”经济学期刊的网络分析
title_secondary: Network analysis of “top-five” economics journals
authors: Gregori Galofré-Vilà
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • In economics journals, the share of theoretical work declined between 2000 and 2024, while empirical research, especially in development, labor, and public economics, expanded and received substantially higher citation counts. • Network analysis of economics journals reveals persistent concentrations of scholarly influence. • In the economics discipline, a small set of elite U.S. universities occupies central positions in citation and co-authorship networks. • Despite changes in research topics and methods, the structure of scholarly knowledge production in economics remains hierarchical, suggesting that intellectual innovation occurs within a stable institutional core. This paper examines patterns in knowledge production within the top-five economics journals from 2000 to 2024. Drawing on the full set of published articles and associated bibliometric details, citations, co-authorship links, and institutional affiliations, I document notable shifts in the orientation of research. The share of theoretical work has declined, while empirical fields, particularly development, labor, and public economics, have expanded. Network analysis shows that although the substantive questions and analytical approaches in top-five journals are changing, a small group of U.S. universities continues to account for a disproportionate share of highly cited work and occupies central positions in citation networks, a core that at the same time facilitates communication and exchange across fields.
abstract_zh: 在2000年至2024年间，经济学期刊中理论研究的比重有所下降，而实证研究，尤其是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学领域，则不断扩展并获得了显著更高的引用次数。对经济学期刊的网络分析揭示了学术影响力的持续集中现象。在经济学学科内，少数美国精英大学在引用和合著网络中占据核心位置。尽管研究主题和方法发生了变化，学术知识生产的结构在经济学中仍保持层级性，这表明知识创新发生在一个稳定的制度核心之内。本文考察了2000年至2024年间五大顶级经济学期刊中的知识生产模式。基于全部已发表文章及其相关的文献计量信息、引用、合著关系和机构归属，我记录了研究方向上的显著转变。理论工作的比例有所下降，而实证领域，特别是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学，则有所扩张。网络分析显示，尽管五大顶级期刊的实质性问题和分析方法正在变化，少数美国大学群体继续占据高被引工作的不成比例份额，并在引用网络中处于中心位置，这一核心同时促进了跨领域的交流与交换。

title: Economic or political uncertainty in early life reduces later tolerance
title_zh: 早期经济或政治不确定性降低后期容忍度
title_primary: 早期经济或政治不确定性降低后期容忍度
title_secondary: Economic or political uncertainty in early life reduces later tolerance
authors: Niclas Berggren, Andreas Bergh, Therese Nilsson
official: 官方在线 2026-02-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: • Economic or political uncertainty in early life reduces subsequent tolerance. • Uncertainty at ages 6–12 and 18–25 most strongly reduces adult tolerance. • Uncertainty exposure after age 25 is rarely related to later tolerance. • Strong democratic traditions neutralize uncertainty’s long-run effect on tolerance. This study examines whether exposure to economic-political uncertainty during formative years has enduring effects on tolerance. To quantify uncertainty, we use the World Uncertainty Index, a text-based measure of the frequency of the term “uncertain” in the country report of the Economist Intelligence Unit. We link its mean value during six age intervals to later-in-life tolerance toward gays and lesbians, using data from the European Social Survey. Employing a quasi-experimental design, we document a robust negative relationship: more uncertainty during formative years predicts diminished tolerance in adulthood. This effect appears most clearly during middle childhood (ages 6–12) and the transition to adulthood (ages 18–25). Exposure after 25 almost never has an impact. The main result is moderated by democratic quality. In countries with robust democratic traditions, procedural legitimacy and participatory socialization seem to undo the negative impact of uncertainty. These findings demonstrate that uncertainty has long-term negative cultural consequences, but also that democratic institutions foster resilience.

title: CEO–chairperson cultural proximity and corporate social responsibility
title_zh: CEO-董事长文化亲近度与企业社会责任
title_primary: CEO-董事长文化亲近度与企业社会责任
title_secondary: CEO–chairperson cultural proximity and corporate social responsibility
authors: Chen Song, Mingqun Li, Zhenxing Xiong
official: 官方在线 2025-09-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Dialect reflects distinct cultural traits and fosters special interpersonal connections. As corporate social responsibility (CSR) becomes increasingly essential for sustainable corporate development worldwide, this study employs CEO – chairperson dialect sharing (CCDS) as a proxy for cultural proximity to examine its influence on CSR. Using a panel of 1,350 publicly listed Chinese firms from 2010 to 2022 and a fixed-effects model, the results show that CCDS is positively associated with CSR. This effect is stronger in non-state-owned enterprises and firms located in the hometowns of CEOs and chairpersons, but it weakens in environments with low market competition and high financial constraints. The findings remain robust across various checks. Overall, the results suggest that CCDS enhances corporate socially responsible practices. This study contributes to the understanding of the positive role of cultural proximity in CSR and offers practical implications for corporate top management selection. The results imply that firms are encouraged to hire CEOs and chairpersons with similar cultural backgrounds to promote CSR engagement.
abstract_zh: 方言体现了独特的文化特征，并促进了特殊的人际联系。随着企业社会责任（CSR）在全球企业可持续发展中日益重要，本研究以CEO与董事长方言共享（CCDS）作为文化亲近度的代理变量，探讨其对CSR的影响。基于2010年至2022年间1350家中国上市公司的面板数据及固定效应模型，结果显示CCDS与CSR呈正相关。这一效应在非国有企业及CEO和董事长家乡所在地的企业中更为显著，但在市场竞争程度低和财务约束高的环境中则有所减弱。上述发现经过多种稳健性检验后依然成立。总体而言，研究结果表明CCDS促进了企业社会责任实践的提升。本研究有助于深化对文化亲近度在CSR中积极作用的认知，并为企业高层管理人员选拔提供实践启示。研究结果建议，企业应倾向于聘用文化背景相似的CEO和董事长，以促进CSR参与。

title: Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
title_zh: 具有持久性和暂时性低效率的半参数随机前沿模型的贝叶斯估计
title_primary: 具有持久性和暂时性低效率的半参数随机前沿模型的贝叶斯估计
title_secondary: Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
authors: Puguang Nie, Christopher F. Parmeter, Valentin Zelenyuk, Xibin Zhang
official: 官方在线 2025-08-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose kernel estimators for the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies in a generalized panel data stochastic frontier model. This approach relaxes the conventional distributional assumptions imposed on the inefficiencies, thereby increasing robustness. A Bayesian sampling algorithm is developed to estimate all model parameters and unobserved entities, as well as the bandwidths needed to construct the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies. The advantages of our estimator and sampling algorithm are demonstrated through numerical studies based on pseudo-samples. We find that our estimation approach outperforms conventional Bayesian estimation, providing more accurate estimates of firm-level inefficiencies. We also apply the approach to analyze the cost frontier and related characteristics for a panel of large US commercial banks, and discuss differences relative to the traditional Bayesian framework. Our estimator reveals that the high-density region of transient inefficiency varies over time, whereas the conventional approach does not possess such a feature. Moreover, the contribution of persistent inefficiency to the total inefficiency revealed by our approach is slightly more than half of that suggested by the conventional framework.
abstract_zh: 我们针对广义面板数据随机前沿模型中的持久性与暂时性无效率密度，提出了核估计方法。该方法放宽了对无效率项的传统分布假设，从而增强了稳健性。我们开发了一种贝叶斯采样算法，用以估计所有模型参数、未观测实体以及构建持久性和暂时性无效率密度所需的带宽。通过基于伪样本的数值研究，我们展示了所提估计器及采样算法的优势。研究发现，我们的估计方法优于传统贝叶斯估计，能更精确地估计企业层面的无效率。我们还应用该方法分析了一组大型美国商业银行的成本前沿及相关特征，并讨论了与传统贝叶斯框架的差异。我们的估计器揭示，暂时性无效率的高密度区域随时间变化，而传统方法不具备此特性。此外，我们方法揭示的持久性无效率对总无效率的贡献，略高于传统框架所建议的一半。
